author: AkonFire
quote: 16 years, just for this?! I know Rockstar said they were aiming to set the bar for realism quite high—much like in RDR2—but it feels like it completely ruins the game's dynamic. Unlike GTA V, which struck a balance between arcade-style gameplay and realism—making it genuinely fun—this... well, I’m not so sure. The graphics are excellent, no complaints there, but as for the rest, I’m honestly disappointed.
